intro.h2: A Green Bay cabinet shop that listens first
paragraphs: Oak Ridge builds custom cabinets Green Bay families use every day, for brand new homes and for kitchens that need a fresh start. The shop has been in business for more than 35 years and still works out of the same kind of place you would hope for: a real workshop on N Packerland Dr.

What reviewers bring up again and again is the people. Jeff helps you plan, and more than one customer says he suggested changes that made their first idea better. Adam installs. One family who updated a 39 year old home called the quality outstanding, and another chose Oak Ridge over the builder's cabinet supplier because they simply felt more comfortable.

about.text: Oak Ridge Custom Cabinets, Inc. is a Green Bay cabinet maker at 2660 N Packerland Dr, and it has been in business for more than 35 years. The shop builds cabinets for new homes and for remodels, and says it likes nothing more than seeing a client's plans come true. Customers mostly know the team by first name. Jeff works with you on the design and is quick to suggest improvements. Adam handles installation. The shop also runs its own spray room for finishing, and Oak Ridge is listed in the Brown County Home Builders Association directory.

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets in Green Bay, WI
service_area.text: Oak Ridge Custom Cabinets works from its shop at 2660 N Packerland Dr in Green Bay, WI 54303. Homeowners and home builders in Green Bay come to the shop for kitchen cabinets in new houses and in remodels. If you are building or remodeling nearby and are not sure whether your project fits, call (920) 499-8855 during shop hours and ask.

faq.h2: Questions about custom cabinets in Green Bay

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Call the shop at (920) 499-8855 or email orccgb@gmail.com. Let us know whether the cabinets are for a new home or a remodel and share any measurements or ideas you already have. As one reviewer put it, just give them a call for a quote.

items.q: Do you work on new construction or only remodels?
items.a: Both. Oak Ridge builds cabinets for new construction and for remodels. Reviewers include a family who just had a new home built with Oak Ridge as their cabinet maker, and a couple who put new kitchen cabinets into a 39 year old home.

items.q: Do you install the cabinets too?
items.a: Yes. Oak Ridge has its own installer. Customers have named Adam, the installer, in their Google reviews and said he did an outstanding job, so the team that builds your cabinets is also the team that puts them in your kitchen.
The shop is open Monday to Thursday from 8 AM to 5 PM and Friday from 8 AM to 12 PM. It is closed on Saturday and Sunday. Calling during these hours is the quickest way to reach someone at the shop.

Oak Ridge Custom Cabinets is at 2660 N Packerland Dr, Green Bay, WI 54303. It is a working cabinet shop with its own spray room for finishing, so call ahead at (920) 499-8855 to make sure the right person is available when you stop by.

final_cta.text: Call Oak Ridge for a quote and talk through your plans with someone who has built cabinets in Green Bay for more than 35 years.
